reading_dialog.title: Reading Dialog
reading_dialog.body:
MoonLine's reusable reading dialog is designed for long-form UI copy.

This sample body intentionally spans multiple paragraphs so the viewport must scroll instead of shrinking the text.

In production, the same dialog can host lore, tutorials, settings explanations, or patch notes while keeping focus and modal behavior consistent.
